description: Finish a MULTIPART project upload started by doseedo_get_project_upload_url: pass every uploaded part's number and ETag (from the PUT response header; quotes optional). Returns the project_key to pass to doseedo_convert_project / doseedo_import_project. All parts except the last must be the same size (what `split -b` produces). abort:true discards the upload instead.

abort.description: true = abandon the upload and free its parts (no project_key results).

parts.description: [{part_number, etag}] for EVERY part, in order.

name: doseedo_complete_project_upload
